title: Centre the bookmark card
summary: Show the bookmark card centred at desktop and mobile widths.
body:
## What to build

Render the bookmark card on the home page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Read the page at 1280px and 375px wide. Confirm that the card centres and the header reads clearly.

title: Show a focus ring on every control
summary: Make every control show a focus ring when tabbed to.
body:
## What to build

Style the interactive elements.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tab through the page and confirm that every control shows a focus ring.

title: Follow the browser theme in the tab title
summary: Show the page title in the tab in light and dark mode.
body:
## What to build

Set the document title.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Open the page in light mode and in dark mode. Confirm that the page title shows in the tab.

title: Show an alert when the API fails
summary: Show an alert when the bookmark API returns an error.
body:
## What to build

Handle API errors in the bookmark list.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Force an API failure and confirm that the alert appears.

title: Persist a bookmark
summary: Save a bookmark and read it back from the API.
body:
## What to build

Add the bookmarks table, repository and API route.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `bun test packages/bookmarks` passes and reports the new bookmark test.
